classification.selection: Among valid feasible new variants, highest primary then H12; must improve at least primary/H12/relevant subgroup and differ from official baseline predictions.

regression.selection: Among valid feasible paired/inner variants, lowest primary then H12; do not use public score. New candidate must differ from baseline.

interpretation: These practical eligibility guards allow small/mixed experiments for one external evaluation per task; they are not statistical significance or automatic final-model promotion.
